releaseNotes:
SAM 0.12.18 reduces background network traffic while preserving local software detection and usage history.

- Remote support checks every two minutes; background support reply notifications every five minutes.
- The active support chat refreshes every thirty seconds and pauses while another window is active.
- Empty application policies no longer trigger a request every five seconds.
- Unchanged inventories upload at most once per day; changes upload on the next scan.
- Network failures use exponential cooldown and honor Retry-After. Unsent events remain queued.

Remote support requests may take up to two minutes to reach a device. Background reply notifications may take up to five minutes. Local process detection remains every five seconds.

This release requires the updated agent-api backend, including /api/agent/support-summary.
